name: get_order
description: Look up an order. Needs both the order number and the email address the order was placed with; if either is wrong the order is reported as not found. Returns status, items, totals and any existing return request.

customer_email.description: Email address the order was placed with.

name: check_inventory
description: Check current stock for a product by SKU. Returns units available, whether it is in stock, and the expected restock date when it is not.

sku.description: Product SKU as shown on the order, for example KB-ALU-75.

name: request_return
description: Open a return for a delivered order inside the return window. Creates a return request for the full order and returns its ID and refund amount; it does not move any money. Safe to call twice: a second call returns the existing request.

customer_email.description: Email address the order was placed with.

reason.description: The customer's reason for the return, in their words.

name: search_policies
description: Search the store's policy documents (returns, refunds, shipping, warranty). Use it before answering any policy question, and answer from the passages it returns.

query.description: A natural language question, for example 'how long do refunds take'.
